body:
### Summary

Kaspersky Free (System Watcher component) triggers a false positive detection on uv.exe based on heuristic behavioral analysis during execution, flagging it as PDM:Trojan.Win32.Generic.

Environment Details
OS: Windows 11 x64

Application: uv.exe

Path: C:\Users\<username>\.local\bin\uv.exe

Antivirus: Kaspersky Free

Detection Engine / Component: System Watcher (Behavior Analysis)

Databases Release Date: 8/3/2026 2:46:00 AM

File Hash Information
MD5: B1AE8C519FBE2C4F42F1FA0D4BE1423B

Detection Details
Plaintext
Event: Malicious object detected
Application: uv.exe
Component: System Watcher
Result description: Detected
Type: Trojan
Name: PDM:Trojan.Win32.Generic
Threat level: High
Object type: Process
Reason: Behavior analysis
Steps to Reproduce
Install uv via the official installation script or binary release on Windows.

Run standard uv commands (e.g., uv pip install, uv venv, etc.).

Kaspersky System Watcher intercepts execution and prompts a heuristic malware detection pop-up requesting a system restart/disinfection.

### Platform

Windows 11 x64

### Version

uv 0.12.1 (329541a50 2026-07-31 x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)

### Python version

Python 3.13.13
title: Kaspersky System Watcher flags uv.exe as PDM:Trojan.Win32.Generic
